content: Letter 37 is a brief letter of eulogy and friendship whose epithet niqābat-qibābī, MK says, indicates Qāsim-i Anvār held the post of naqīb in Herat, with a postscript greeting his disciples and the jurist ʿAzīz Jalāl Yūsuf (probably Jalāl al-Dīn Yūsuf Awbahī). Letter 38 was written after several days in his company, 'presumably in Herat and either in 830/1427 or 834/1431' (MK), and addresses him with a long eulogistic string of titles.
refers_to_primary: Munshaʾāt-i Turka, letters 37 and 38 (TMN/MS pp. 29-31; TMN/D pp. 207-10)
